newsitem.title: USA: Scholz unit splits off from Cordiant's Bates.
newsitem.headline: Scholz unit splits off from Cordiant's Bates.

text.p: Cordiant Plc's Bates division said its Scholz & Friends unit in Hamburg, Germany will be set up as an independent advertising agency.

Cordiant said the decision to turn Scholz into an independent firm was "due to its outstanding success" at winning new business. Advertising Age reports its annual billings for 1995 were $339 million.
Cordiant bought the company in 1985. Scholz was founded in 1982, when Jurgen Scholz left Team/BBDO of Hamburg to set up his own agency.

Scholz has expanded rapidly as an agency based in Germany handling international business. Its nine offices across Europe include new shops in Athens, Brussels, Budapest, Madrid, Warsaw and Vienna. It also has plans for a Far Eastern expansion.
Scholz will continue to report within Cordiant to Michael Bungey, chairman and ceo of Bates and a Cordiant director.
